This '''[[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]]''' dignitary was a '''minister''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She was present with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] and a [[Unidentified male Devaronian minister|fellow minister]] at the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]] on her planet when it came under attack from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces under the command of [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]].
